This is the first release of MonitorControl for Windows: the same app, with the same features, now on Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64 and ARM64).

Download `MonitorControl.4.4.0.exe` (or `MonitorControl.4.4.0-arm64.exe` for ARM PCs) and run it. No administrator rights are needed, and the app updates itself.

Releases are not code signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch (*More info → Run anyway*). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's Changed

- Brightness, contrast and volume control of external displays through DDC/CI.
- Native brightness control of the built-in display of laptops, with brightness sync to external displays.
- Software dimming (gamma table, or an overlay for virtual displays and HDR) and combined hardware + software dimming.
- Notification area sliders: per display, display under the mouse, or one combined slider.
- Universal keyboard shortcuts (`Ctrl+Alt+↑/↓` brightness, `Ctrl+Alt+→/←` volume, `Ctrl+Alt+M` mute), volume keys, brightness keys of external keyboards, custom shortcuts.
- Windows 11 style OSD.
- All the advanced per-display options of the macOS app.
- 20 languages.
